title: Log rows cannot be edited or deleted
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the log holds at least one row.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" page menu beside "New Credit Term".
  2. Click "Audit Log".
  3. Click a Details cell.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit Terms Log" window opens.
  • There is no edit, delete or menu control on any row.

Step 3:

  • The text cannot be changed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)
